children: NuScale Power’s shares jumped 15.26%, closing at $11.18 with a high of $11.37 and a low of $9.90. The stock’s 52-week range is $7.21 to $57.42.
The nuclear sector saw a resurgence, with leveraged ETFs tied to NuScale among the biggest gainers, driven by a rally in small modular reactor stocks.
Casey’s shares fell 2.99% to $733.49, with an intraday high of $767.98 and a low of $730.30. The stock’s 52-week range is $497.38 to $927.85.

Casey’s General Stores reported first-quarter revenue of $5.68 billion, above the $5.57 billion analyst estimate, while EPS of $7.37 topped expectations of $6.72. Inside same-store sales rose 3.2% year over year, while fuel same-store gallons fell 0.3%; the company expected fiscal 2027 inside same-store sales growth of 2%-5% and planned to open at least 120 stores.
Qualcomm’s stock rose 3.17% to $174.09, with a high of $183.49 and a low of $172.04. The 52-week range is $121.99 to $259.92.
